security_audit.summary: Most static URL, environment, and chain_id alerts are documentation false positives. The skill intentionally instructs agents to install and run Chainbase CLI, including remote queries, SQL, credentials, and optional x402 payment setup. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before installing or running chainbase-cli or npx. Pin a trusted CLI version in the documentation.

remediation.issue: Private key and x402 payment setup
remediation.suggestion: Do not ask agents to handle wallet private keys. Require human setup outside Claude, Codex, and Claude Code with clear spending limits.
Validate addresses, chain IDs, topic IDs, and SQL scope before execution. Quote arguments safely and cap result sizes.

content.value_statement: Blockchain research often needs several tools for tokens, wallets, DeFi, ENS, SQL, and social trends. This skill routes Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to Chainbase workflows for structured Web3 answers.
actual_capabilities: Maps natural language blockchain questions to Chainbase CLI commands.
Looks up token holders, token prices, transfers, metadata, and historical prices.
Queries wallet balances, transaction history, DeFi portfolios, ENS records, and address labels.
Uses Chainbase SQL for custom on-chain questions when fixed commands are not enough.
Retrieves Tops crypto trends, topic details, posts, narrative searches, and social mentions.
limitations: Requires the Chainbase CLI or npx access to run live queries.
Web3 Data may require a Chainbase API key after demo limits are reached.
Results depend on Chainbase and Tops API availability, rate limits, and data freshness.
The skill provides data retrieval guidance, not investment, tax, or legal advice.

use_cases.title: Token Holder Review
use_cases.description: Find top holders, balances, and transfer activity for an ERC20 contract on a chosen EVM chain.

use_cases.title: Wallet Due Diligence
use_cases.description: Review wallet balances, transactions, ENS names, labels, and DeFi positions before deeper investigation.

use_cases.title: Narrative Monitoring
use_cases.description: Track trending crypto topics, representative posts, and recent mentions for a project or market theme.

prompt_templates.title: Check Token Holders

prompt_templates.prompt: Find the top 10 holders for this ERC20 contract on Ethereum and summarize concentration risk.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Wallet
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this wallet on Base. Include token balances, recent transactions, ENS data, and DeFi portfolio positions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Chain Activity
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced custom query across on-chain tables.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Chainbase SQL to compare recent USDC transfer activity on Ethereum and Polygon, then explain the main differences.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor Market Narratives
prompt_templates.prompt: Find current crypto narratives related to restaking, inspect the strongest topic, and summarize key authors and sentiment.

output_examples.input: Who are the top holders of USDT on Ethereum?
output_examples.output: A ranked holder summary with wallet addresses, balances, share estimates, and notes about concentration patterns.

output_examples.input: What is trending in crypto social discussions right now?
output_examples.output: A short trend briefing with top narratives, heat indicators, representative authors, and suggested follow-up topics.

output_examples.input: Review this wallet before I investigate it further.
output_examples.output: A wallet profile covering balances, transactions, ENS records, labels, DeFi positions, and notable activity changes.

best_practices: Confirm the target chain, contract, wallet, or topic before running commands.
Use small limits first, then expand results only when the initial query is useful.
Separate factual data retrieval from financial conclusions or recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not paste wallet private keys or seed phrases into prompts or CLI commands.
Do not run broad SQL queries without limits or a clear data scope.
Do not treat social trend scores as proof of project quality or price direction.

faq.question: What services does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Chainbase for on-chain data and Tops for crypto social intelligence.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Tops does not require a key. Web3 Data uses a demo key by default, but higher limits require a Chainbase API key.

faq.question: Which chains are covered?
faq.answer: The skill lists Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, zkSync, and other EVM chains.

faq.question: Can it run custom SQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can translate custom on-chain questions into Chainbase SQL when fixed CLI commands are insufficient.

faq.question: Can it analyze social narratives?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve trending topics, topic details, posts, narrative search results, and recent mentions through Tops.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. The skill helps retrieve and summarize data. Users must make their own financial and compliance decisions.
